Bill.BriefDescription: Increasing transparency in higher education by requiring certain departmental budget detail to be available online.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to increasing transparency in higher education byrequiring certain departmental budget detail to be available online;adding a new section to chapter 28B.10 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that transparency inhigher education budgeting is essential to the maintenance of publictrust in the higher education system. Such transparency is not only anappropriate check on future higher education cost increases, it shouldalso counteract any perception that public institutions are notadequately accountable for student and taxpayer dollars. Therefore, toensure general accessibility to meaningful budget information and toimprove public confidence in the system, the legislature intends torequire that departmental budgets of higher education institutions beposted on their respective web sites.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Institutions of higher education shall post departmental budgets ontheir web sites within sixty days of an institution's approval of its p. 1 HB 2336budget as a whole. The budgets posted online must align with generalhigher education budgeting principles and with the departmental budgetsapproved by the institution of higher education's boards of regents ortrustees.
